verdict.rationale: The speaker diarization docs say each transcript segment is labeled with a speaker, so the output is segmented rather than a plain text blob. That is the only evidence for this story: nothing documents JSON response fields or per-word or per-utterance confidence values. missing for 10: documented JSON response schema with utterances/words arrays, confidence values per word or utterance, independent or hands-on corroboration of the response structure.

support.subject: As a developer, results come back as structured JSON with utterances or segments and confidence values, not just a text blob

citations.quote: Speaker diarization identifies individual speakers in your audio and labels each segment of the transcript with the speaker.
